title: EPSRC Centre For Doctoral Training in Future Fluid Dynamics
about: The University of Leeds EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Future Fluid Dynamics offers a four-year funded integrated MSc and PhD, with 12 funding places. Applications are open for 2027 entry; the deadline is Thursday 7 January 2027 and funding starts 1 October 2027.
requirements: Open route open to UK and overseas-rated students
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the EPSRC Centre For Doctoral Training in Future Fluid Dynamics at the University of Leeds, Leeds, United Kingdom, application deadline 7 Jan 2027. The photo is a United Kingdom country image showing the Elizabeth Tower (Big Ben), the Palace of Westminster and Westminster Bridge in London, not Leeds.
